item: US drug pricing: Inflation Reduction Act negotiation
label: Fact
what_it_says: Medicare negotiates prices once a drug is 7 years (small molecule) or 11 years (biologic) past approval; rounds so far 10 drugs (2026) 15 (2027) 15 incl Part B (2028)
effect_on_biologics_demand: Longer protection for biologics favours biologic R and D over pills
source_title: KFF Key facts about Medicare drug price negotiation
evidence: at least 7 years for small molecule or 11 years for biologics past FDA approval

label: Fact
what_it_says: Enacted 18 Dec 2025 in the FY2026 NDAA (s.851); restricts US federal contracts with named biotechnology companies of concern
effect_on_biologics_demand: CDMO work can move away from listed Chinese firms to other providers
evidence: OMB list of companies due by Dec 2026

label: Fact
what_it_says: Executive order of 12 May 2025; company deals followed (Pfizer 30 Sep 2025; AstraZeneca 10 Oct 2025)
effect_on_biologics_demand: Price pressure on US launches; deals tied to US manufacturing investment
evidence: guaranteeing MFN prices on all new innovative medicines AstraZeneca brings to market

label: Fact
what_it_says: Proclamation of 6 Apr 2026 sets duties on patented drugs and APIs; capped rates for some partners and firms with onshoring deals
effect_on_biologics_demand: Pushes companies to build US plants
evidence: Check rates against the proclamation text

label: Fact
what_it_says: Healthcare venture investment of 60bn across 2167 deals in 2025 up from 45.4bn in 2024
effect_on_biologics_demand: More funded biotechs means more early-stage process development demand
evidence: All healthcare venture not biopharma only

label: Fact
what_it_says: 3.45bn venture capital raised in H1 2026 up 25 percent on H1 2025
effect_on_biologics_demand: Funding recovering in the largest US cluster
